generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The change replaces returning a list containing an `UnresolvedAttribute` with throwing an `IllegalStateException`. Since the error message ("Reference [...] is ambiguous") describes a semantic error in the user's query rather than an internal system failure, throwing an unchecked exception is likely inappropriate. This will cause the entire analysis process to crash instead of allowing the analyzer to collect and report the ambiguity as a diagnostic error to the user.

review_comment:
Actually, I changed my mind on this:

It is the actual name that needs to be unique; otherwise, bugs could slip in because we somehow end up using qualifiers on accident; qualifiers are not respected by our optimization rules, e.g. `mergeOutputAttributes`;  this [PR](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110581) demonstrates that qualifiers are entirely unused, and the validation for the current state should reflect current assumptions.

If we end up using qualifiers after all (I think that's really for the future and we should really remove them until then), we can easily update the validation.
